description: A protocol's trading volume per day (USD) for up to 3650 days: kind dexs (spot DEX volume), options (options notional) or aggregators. The slug is a module from volumes (uniswap-v3) or an AlphaGrowth project slug. Gives the period's total and the latest day's volume on each chain; chain_history=yes adds each chain's daily series. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain_history.description: yes to add each chain's daily series over the same days.

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

slug.description: The protocol's module as volumes lists it, or its project slug.

name: volume_history
title: Volume history
